descriptions.en: Captain [officer.GetName], the commanding officer of the [ship.GetName], served with distinction during the recent engagement that took place in the [system.GetName] system. The Admiralty on [Root.Capital.GetName], recognizing the qualities of a promising flag officer, has decided to promote the Captain to the rank of full commander.
